title: Uncommonly Grassy Russian Duck Paella
description: A unique Russian dish featuring duck confit leg, fermented ingredients, and macrobiotic-friendly components, all cooked in a traditional paella pan. This meal is perfect for a special occasion or a fancy dinner party.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the paella pan over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the duck confit leg to the pan and sear for 2 minutes on each side.
Add the wild rice, fermented cabbage, and grassy sorrel leaves to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the paella pan to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the paella pan from the oven and stir in the lemon juice.
Return the paella pan to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the paella pan from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
